notes: Account: large fintech platform, user-facing assistants + real-time pricing microservices.
Primary ask: deterministic dedicated capacity with explicit throughput guarantees and predictable cost.

POC summary (02/20-03/03): ran 10x A100-80GB equiv, targeted 180k tokens/sec sustained. Observed steady-state ~160k t/s with p95 completion latency 420ms for 512-token completions (missed our target).
They want contract-level minimum tokens/sec at cluster level (min_tokens_per_sec) and clear concurrency caps per-customer to prevent noisy neighbors.

Rivermark proposal asks: guaranteed min 150k tokens/sec sustained, burst allowance 3x sustained for 10 minutes configurable per route, concurrency cap 400 sessions (soft) with automatic throttling and token-backpressure policy.
Requested fallback policy: during longer outages fallback to smaller model family (mosaic-like) with automatic routing and 5-second warmup for KV cache.
Important: SLA penalty language must be acceptable to procurement — they prefer credits rather than termination rights. Legal to draft redlines.
Quote from CTO on scoping call: 'We need predictability — it's more important than raw peak.'
Performance asks for SLA: cluster-level sustained min_tokens_per_sec, p95 request completion < 350ms for 256-token completions when under 90% of guaranteed capacity.
Operational requirements: real-time token-level telemetry in Console, token-by-token cost breakdown, and per-route tracing for debugging.
Security: mandatory SSO/SAML integration, KMS key import, and 7-year audit log retention for trade compliance (they will push for custom retention term in contract).

Hardware ask: reserved capacity planning shows need for 12x A100-80GB equiv to meet targets with headroom (POC used 10x and fell short), want deterministic #GPUs reserved with quarterly scaling windows.
Finance note: prefers annual committed billing with ramp clauses and a predictable overage pricing schedule tied to tokens/sec tiers.
Engineering follow-up items: provide detailed perf curves for models at 512/1024 token lengths, include quantized variants and expected tokens/sec per GPU at 99% CI.
SE comment: need to validate burst safety — engineer to run 3x sustained for 10m stress POC in regional cluster and report.
Deal velocity: high, but wait on legal + procurement — internal timeline 6-8 weeks after SLA signoff to start provisioning.

recommended_terms: Min cluster throughput: 150,000 tokens/sec sustained (measured p50 over 1h windows)
Burst policy: up to 3x sustained for 10 minutes per calendar hour, automatic throttling if bursts exceed 3x or >2 consecutive windows
Concurrency cap: soft cap 400 concurrent active sessions; hard cap 550 with agreed pre-notification and backpressure behavior
Reserved GPUs: initial commitment 12x A100-80GB equiv, quarterly review for scaling +/-20%
Latency SLO: p95 completion < 350ms for 256-token baseline under <=90% guaranteed utilization
SLA credits: tiered credits (5% credits if monthly uptime < guaranteed; escalated credits for repeated misses).
Procurement preference: annual committed invoice with defined overage tiers by tokens/sec tranche
